app.name: Disaster and Emergency Mapping
app.homeLead: Choose a module on the left, then open a solution. It will load in this pane.
app.tagline: A central platform for hazard mapping, risk analytics, and coordinated emergency operations.

organization.name: Rwanda Space Agency
organization.legalName: Government of the Republic of Rwanda

footer.blurb: Supporting disaster preparedness, response and recovery through reliable geospatial information.

disclaimer.title: Data Disclaimer
body: Mapping applications and related geospatial data are provided as-is for planning and operational use. Completeness, accuracy, and currency may vary by source and refresh cycle.
Users should verify critical decisions against authoritative records. Rwanda Space Agency and contributing institutions are not liable for decisions made solely on the basis of these maps.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: This workspace does not collect sign-in credentials. Mapping applications may still load GeoHub or partner portal content according to each application’s sharing settings.
Avoid entering personal credentials into third-party pages unless your institution requires it for a specific secured service.

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: Use this workspace only for lawful, authorized purposes related to disaster and emergency mapping and institutional mandates in Rwanda.
Do not attempt to bypass access controls, scrape protected services, or redistribute proprietary content without permission.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
body: This portal supports keyboard navigation for primary chrome (header, sidebar, and legal pages). Embedded mapping applications inherit accessibility features from their ArcGIS source apps.
If you encounter a barrier, contact your GeoHub administrator so the issue can be routed to the application owner.

modules.name: Disaster Mapping
modules.description: Hazard profiling, susceptibility, and exposure analytics across floods, landslides, earthquakes, storms, lightning, volcanic activity, fire, and gas hazards.

apps.name: Floods Profiling
apps.description: Flood events, susceptibility, and exposure of people and infrastructure.

apps.name: Landslides Profiling
apps.description: Landslide occurrence, slope susceptibility, and assets in the path of risk.

apps.name: Earthquakes Profiling
apps.description: Seismic events, magnitude, and impact on settlements and facilities.

apps.name: Storms Profiling
apps.description: Storm intensity, wind and rainfall, and downstream exposure.

apps.name: Fire Incidents
apps.description: Strike density, seasonal hotspots, and at-risk communities.

apps.name: Disaster damages
apps.description: Disaster effects dashboard for casualties, housing, and evacuations.

modules.name: Emergency Response Management
modules.description: Citizen reporting, field operations, incident tracking, and firefighting resource mapping from alert through recovery.

apps.name: Emergency response Mapping
apps.description: Emergency reporting form in the response experience.

disaster-mapping: Multi-disaster event monitoring with location, time, and severity.
Susceptibility and risk classification by disaster type.
Impact and exposure for population and infrastructure.
Admin analytics from province through village.
Hotspot detection and historical trend analysis.
emergency-response: Public tap-to-report mapping with status tracking.
Field collection for incidents, damage, and assistance.
Central incident registry with Active and Resolved states.
Effects dashboards for casualties, housing, and evacuations.
